pages.title: Tabbyrium Blossom
pages.text: By surrounding an Oak Sapling with $(2)Trinitite$(0) and rotten flesh, you create a $(2)Tabbyrium Blossom Sapling$(0).$(br2)When grown, it sprouts a 3–5 block tall stalk that extends root tendrils across the terrain (capped at ~18 crust blocks). Its crown $(a)Spore Pod$(0) actively nurtures pulsing crystal clusters along these veins.

pages.title: Radiation & Wither
pages.text: $(c)BIOLOGICAL HAZARD:$(0)$(br)Tabbyrium fields leach organic matter. Stepping onto $(8)Tabbyrium Crust$(0) or brush against $(a)Tabbyrium Clusters$(0) will violently afflict you with $(4)Wither$(0) and lacerations.$(br2)Harvest clusters at stage 3 using a pickaxe for maximum shard yield.

pages.title: Refinery & Silos
pages.text: Process $(a)Tabbyrium Shards$(0) (10,000 FE) or dense $(a)Crystals$(0) (45,000 FE) inside the $(2)Tabbyrium Refinery$(0).$(br2)Store excess power in $(6)Tabbyrium Silos$(0) (1,000,000 FE capacity). Beware: if your silos run full, tactical EVA alerts may sound!
